title: Agreement with a fixed-choice run
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine, let $b$ be a Boolean choice bit, let $w$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input. Suppose that at every time $j<|w|$, if the run of the machine that always uses choice $b$ from $c$ has state $q$, then the two transitions of $M$ at state $q$ agree for every input symbol and tuple of work-tape symbols. Then running $M$ from $c$ under $w$ gives the same configuration as running the machine with choice fixed to $b$ for $|w|$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $c$ on a fixed input.
For every $j<|w|$ and state $q$ reached by the fixed-choice run at time $j$, the two transition functions agree at $q$.
